title: kbingest map's .NET value shapes accept the machine's own host and user names
goal: A .NET evaluated value equal to or containing the mapping machine's host name or user name (a property set from GetEnvironmentVariable('COMPUTERNAME') or 'USERNAME') is left out of the map with a note, since a TFM or package id shape alone accepts any single token; a test named kbingest_map_dotnet_machine_names with a planted PL-LT-00123 host and jan.kowalski user proves it (sprint SP-xourq2gj review finding 3)
